shortDescription: Executes a command and responds to prompts

options.name: chdir
options.description: Change into this directory before running the command.

options.name: command
options.description: The command module takes command to run.

options.name: creates
options.description: A filename, when it already exists, this step will B(not) be run.

options.name: echo
options.description: Whether or not to echo out your response strings.

options.name: removes
options.description: A filename, when it does not exist, this step will B(not) be run.

options.name: responses
options.description: Mapping of prompt regular expressions and corresponding answer(s). Each key in O(responses) is a Python regex U(https://docs.python.org/3/library/re.html#regular-expression-syntax). The value of each key is a string or list of strings. If the value is a string and the prompt is encountered multiple times, the answer will be repeated. Provide the value as a list to give different answers for successive matches.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Amount of time in seconds to wait for the expected strings. Use V(null) to disable timeout.
